issues.location: derivability inclusion at line 77 and implication-residuation inclusion at line 93
issues.finding: Both claims use subset rather than subseteq, leaving allowance of equality unclear. Derivability is reflexive, and implication application can yield the entire consequent truth set; both claims require non-strict inclusion.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use subseteq in both displayed inclusion conditions.

issues.finding: The biconditional between derivability and semantic inclusion omits the all-model quantifier. Inclusion in one chosen model does not imply derivability.
issues.proposed_resolution: State explicitly that the inclusion must hold in every topological model, matching the previous paragraph's entailment explanation.

issues.location: explanation of the applied interior notation
issues.finding: The notation Interior(V) is called the function, but it denotes the function's value, namely the interior of V.
issues.proposed_resolution: Describe Interior(V) as the resulting interior set, preserving the formula and the union-of-open-subsets definition.

translation_treatment: Translated the topology and model definitions, interior operation and connective motivation. Clarified non-strict inclusion and universal model quantification, and distinguished the interior operator's value from the operator itself. Localized ordinary prose inside the set-builder equation.
